entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it a few weeks ago and it's not what I wanted. Just process the return.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It doesn't matter! I don't want it! Your website promised easy returns. I'm calling to get my money back. Are you going to honor your own policy or not?

I understand your frustration, sir. Let me just pull up your order details... I see it was delivered 18 days ago. Unfortunately, our updated return policy for wearable items is quite strict for sanitation and hygiene reasons.
What are you talking about? What does hygiene have to do with anything? It's a sensor that goes on a bike crank!

My apologies, I was thinking of another product. However, for a simple 'change of mind' return, our policy states you need to request that within the first 10 days. At 18 days, I'm afraid it's too late to process a refund for that reason.

TOO LATE?! ARE YOU SERIOUS?! This is absolutely unacceptable! I want to speak to your manager right now! This is a bait-and-switch, and I will be posting reviews about this ridiculous policy on every single fitness blog and retail site!

Sir, I understand you're upset. Please allow me to put you on a brief hold while I double-check the official documentation for this specific product. I want to ensure I am giving you 100% correct information.
Fine. But you'd better come back with a different answer.

Thank you for holding. Sir, I want to sincerely apologize. You are correct and I was mistaken. I was looking at a policy for a different product line. For the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, our standard 90-day return policy is in effect. You are well within that period.
So... wait. You're saying I can return it for a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. My deepest apologies for the confusion and frustration I caused. I am processing the return authorization for you right now and I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. You can just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off.
Oh. Okay. Well... good. That's what I expected in the first place. Thank you.
You're very welcome, and again, my apologies for the mix-up. Your refund will be processed as soon as the return is received at our warehouse. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
